test "spec parses `instance run` with flags" do
    assert {:ok, [:instance, :run], parsed} =
             Optimus.parse(DockdCLI.CLI.spec(), [
               "instance",
               "run",
               "--image",
               "busybox",
               "--name",
               "w"
             ])

    assert parsed.options.image == "busybox" and parsed.options.name == "w"
  end
